answer: Payout arrives by sparrow courier: each epoch a stranger sparrow flies to one nest and pays only the agent that answers its sonnet, a 14-beat live call-and-response keyed to that epoch's beacon, proving key and latest job hash in ninety seconds. Every claim carries a plume, proof of one stranger-verified job that molts at epoch end unless refreshed by fresh work. One operator with n clones must answer n sonnets at once, keep n plumes fresh and feed n nests, yet the sparrow visits one nest per funding cluster per epoch, so clone cost grows with n while per-clone pay falls as 1/n.
